column1: # Deliberate differences from Yomitan d3c54c1 (docs/languages.md 8.2), read by tools/check-yomitan.mjs.

column7: The pack strips accents only from a lower-case single word. Yomitan also strips them from a capitalised word, which then matches a proper name before the word itself (Già → Gia, Sarà → Sara, Tornò → Torno), and from phrases (è poi → e poi → eppoi): with Yomitan's processor, 112 instead of 47 of the 233,208 lookups of five Gutenberg texts have a first result the dictionary's rows do not confirm (sources/measure.py text, wty-it-en).

Inputs that start with a combining mark, or hold the ångström sign (U+212B), which no Italian word does: the pack's pattern needs a letter before the mark it removes and writes the result in NFC (Å), where Yomitan removes every mark and leaves NFD.
